lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 새 사업 손익 계산해 봤어요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, did you calculate the new business's profit and loss?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, sae saeop sonik gyesanhae bwasseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 올해 예산으로는 적자가 날 게 뻔해요.
lines.en: Yes, with this year's budget, a deficit is obvious.
lines.roman: Ne, olhae yesaneuroneun jeokjaga nal ge ppeonhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Will there be no profit at all?
lines.learner: 첫해에는 손해를 볼 게 뻔해요. 투자가 커서요.
lines.en: We'll obviously lose money the first year. The investment is big.
lines.roman: Cheotaeeneun sonhaereul bol ge ppeonhaeyo. Tujaga keoseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How much more capital do we need?
lines.learner: 자본이 지금보다 두 배는 필요할 거예요.
lines.en: We'll need about twice the capital we have now.
lines.roman: Jaboni jigeumboda du baeneun piryohal geoyeyo.

lines.learner: 거래 조건이 확실하지 않아서 앞이 깜깜해요.
lines.en: The deal terms aren't certain, so the future looks dark.
lines.roman: Georae jogeoni hwaksilhaji anaseo api kkamkkamhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: How do you think the market will react?
lines.learner: 시중에 비슷한 제품이 많아서 고생할 게 뻔해요.
lines.en: There are many similar products, so we'll obviously struggle.
lines.roman: Sijunge biseutan jepumi manaseo gosaenghal ge ppeonhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Still, our product is kind of unique.
lines.en: Right. At least the design is unique, luckily.

lines.beaver_en: How is consumers' income these days?
lines.en: Income dropped, so spending has fallen a lot too.

lines.learner: 네, 장기 투자로 보면 이익이 날 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, as a long-term investment, it will make a profit.
lines.roman: Ne, janggi tujaro bomyeon iigi nal geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Other departments' interests are tangled up in it too.
lines.learner: 네, 이해관계를 잘 조정하는 게 중요해요.
lines.en: Yes, it's important to balance everyone's interests well.
lines.roman: Ne, ihaegwangyereul jal jojeonghaneun ge jungyohaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Then let's report to the manager together.
lines.learner: 네, 예산안을 정리해서 내일 보여 드릴게요.
lines.en: Okay, I'll organize the budget plan and show you tomorrow.
lines.roman: Ne, yesananeul jeongnihaeseo naeil boyeo deurilgeyo.
